start_rule: daily cron M H -> Monday H:M; otherwise Monday 12:00

args.Text: The outdoor fine dust level is $Pm10Weather

joi.name: Scenario
joi.script:
Pm10Weather = (#WeatherProvider).weatherProvider_pm10Weather
all(#Speaker).speaker_speak("The outdoor fine dust level is " + Pm10Weather)

pairs.command_eng: Announce the outdoor fine dust level using the speaker.
Lock the safe.
Lock all door locks in the storage.
Turn off all lights in the bedroom.
Set all air purifiers in the warehouse to high mode.
Set all humidifiers in the bedroom to auto mode.
If the speaker is playing, stop it.
If no one is present in the office, turn off the office air conditioner.
If the temperature is 18 degrees or below and someone is detected, set the air conditioner to heat mode and 22 degrees.
If the face ID 'family' is recognized at the entrance and the door lock is locked , unlock the door lock.

joi.name: Scenario

pairs.command_eng: If the warehouse fine dust level is 100 or higher and the air purifier is in auto mode, switch it to high mode and say through the warehouse speaker "Switching to high mode".

args.Text: Motion is detected at the entrance or motion is detected on the balcony

joi.name: Scenario

pairs.command_eng: If motion is detected at the entrance or motion is detected on the balcony, announce through the living room speaker.
When the garage door is opened, take a picture with the garage camera.
If any presence sensor on floor 1 detects presence, turn on all lights on floor 1.
If smoke is detected in the kitchen, sound the kitchen siren in fire mode.
When button 1 of the multi-button is pressed, turn on all lights in the bedroom.

joi.name: Scenario

pairs.command_eng: Each time the door is opened, turn on all lights in the hallway and living room.
Set the air conditioner temperature to 24 degrees and change it to 26 degrees after 1 hour.
Turn on the kitchen light and turn on the kitchen dehumidifier 10 seconds later.
When any air purifier in the office switches to sleep mode, turn off the light after 10 minutes.

joi.name: Scenario

pairs.command_eng: When smoke is detected in the living room, sound all fire alarms. Then, every 10 seconds, speak "Please evacuate" through the speaker.

joi.name: Scenario

pairs.command_eng: When any presence sensor on the 1st floor detects presence, sound all emergency sirens for 3 seconds every minute thereafter and then turn them off.
Repeat opening and closing the bedroom window every 2 hours.

joi.name: Scenario

pairs.command_eng: Each time button 4 of the multi-button is pressed, cycle the living room light brightness through 25→50→75 (repeating).
Every 11 PM, lock all doors with even tags.
At 1 PM, open all blinds.
Every 30 minutes from 7 PM to 10 PM, check the robot vacuum cleaner and start it in auto mode if it is stopped.
Every 10 PM, if presence is detected in the living room, turn on all lights.
Check every 5 minutes from 10 PM to 11 PM and turn it off when charging is complete.
Check humidity every 10 minutes; if it's 50 or higher, turn off the humidifier; if it's 20 or lower, turn on the humidifier and set it to auto mode.
Every 5 minutes from 1 PM to 3 PM, repeat opening and closing the valve.
Every 10 minutes from now until 3 PM, sound the emergency siren for 5 seconds and then turn it off.
Every hour from 6 PM to 8 PM, if someone is detected on the 1st floor, turn on all 1st floor lights.
Every 1 second, if the living room humidity is at most 30%, turn on the humidifier plug; otherwise if it is at least 55%, turn off the humidifier plug.

joi.name: Scenario

pairs.command_eng: If a person is detected in the living room for at least 30 seconds, turn on the living room TV plug.

joi.name: Scenario

pairs.command_eng: If the TV plug power stays below 10W for at least 15 minutes, turn off the TV plug.

args.Text: Motion detected in the living room or bedroom.

joi.name: Scenario

pairs.command_eng: If motion is detected in either the living room or the bedroom, announce through the living room speaker.

joi.name: Scenario

pairs.command_eng: Every 1 minute, announce "lunch time" through the speaker. Total 3 times.

joi.name: Scenario

pairs.command_eng: If the office plug power stays below 5W for at least 10 minutes, announce 'Device is idle' through the speaker every 2 minutes, 3 times.

args.Text: The robot vacuum cleaner is stuck

joi.name: Scenario

pairs.command_eng: When the robot vacuum cleaner starts running, if it is not docked within 2 hours, announce 'The robot vacuum cleaner is stuck' through the speaker.
